offers_products.reason: Manufactures travel trailers, fifth wheels, toy haulers and Class A, B and C motorhomes under Airstream, Jayco, Heartland and others.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling RVs; service and repair support is incidental to vehicle sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Families and RVers choose and use the RV brands, buying through dealers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: RVs are sold to independent dealers who buy them for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: RVs are bought once every several years; sales are one-off vehicle purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary leisure vehicles; buyers easily postpone purchases in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Motorhomes, fifth wheels and travel trailers are large, infrequent purchases for buyers.

people_delivered.reason: A manufacturer; customers pay for built RVs, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: End buyers are households, and dealers are mostly independent, small to mid-sized businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: RV assembly relies on labor-intensive plants and purchased components; capital needs are moderate versus heavy industry.

notes: Asset-heavy is a borderline call, since it runs many manufacturing plants.
